name: openapi-spec
title: OpenAPI Spec
blurb: OpenAPI 3.1 first: spectral lint, redocly bundle and docs, contract tests that validate live responses against the document
default_description: A contract-first JSON API documented with OpenAPI 3.1.

verify.name: http
verify.cmd: PORT=5399 node src/main.js >.oas.log 2>&1 & srv=$!; ok=1; for _ in $(seq 1 120); do if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5399/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=0; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; if [ $ok -ne 0 ]; then cat .oas.log; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; health=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5399/health); body=$(curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:5399/stats?text=hello%20world%0A'); post=$(curl -fsS -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{"text":"a b\nc\n"}' http://127.0.0.1:5399/stats); bad=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}' http://127.0.0.1:5399/stats); missing=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5399/nope); kill $srv 2>/dev/null; wait $srv 2>/dev/null; printf '%s' "$health" | grep -q '"status":"ok"' && printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q '"lines":1' && printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q '"bytes":12' && printf '%s' "$post" | grep -q '"words":3' && test "$bad" = 422 && test "$missing" = 404
